description:
Outcome: Assignments respect household uniqueness and returning-gardener priority, from brief.md §Rules.
Scope: Eligibility from prior-season holdings and exclusive Feb 1 local-midnight cutoff; returning-first initial cohort, FCFS within cohorts, one household per plot and one plot per household per season; atomic assignment/audit using T-006 application contract.
Excludes: Automatic preference optimizer, coordinator UI and plot map.
Acceptance: No new applicant assignment before cutoff or ahead of eligible pending returners in the initial round. Returning applicants may be allocated earlier. Reused/double/concurrent assignments rejected without partial state; cross-season holdings allowed. Applicants exactly at cutoff do not receive returning priority.
Behaviour: Explain rejected actions and stale conflicts; no silent overwrite or loss of household/plot constraints.
Verification: TDD for prior holdings, insufficient capacity, tied timestamps, household/plot uniqueness and concurrent assignments. Fake-clock tests: reject early new-applicant allocation; preserve priority for application immediately before cutoff; exclude at-cutoff application.
Prerequisites: T-002, T-005, T-006.
Assumptions: Manual allocation; initial cohorts ordered FCFS; preferences advisory. Local cutoff is midnight beginning Feb 1 in the target season year.
title: Enforce allocation priority and atomic persistence
